queries.func: SELECT n.nspname schema_name,p.proname function_name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) args,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) definition_md5,length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) source_chars,(length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))-length(replace(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),E'\n',''))) source_newlines,p.prosecdef security_definer,coalesce(array_to_string(p.proconfig,','),'') config FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('private','public') ORDER BY 1,2,3,p.oid
queries.pol: SELECT n.nspname schema_name,c.relname table_name,p.polname policy_name,p.polcmd command,p.polpermissive permissive,coalesce((SELECT string_agg(r.rolname,',' ORDER BY r.rolname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.oid=ANY(p.polroles)),'PUBLIC') roles,coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid,true),'') using_expr,coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid,true),'') check_expr FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('private','public') ORDER BY 1,2,3
queries.trg: SELECT n.nspname schema_name,c.relname table_name,t.tgname trigger_name,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) ddl,md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) ddl_md5,t.tgenabled enabled FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND n.nspname IN ('private','public') ORDER BY 1,2,3
queries.rel: SELECT n.nspname schema_name,c.relname table_name,c.relkind::text kind,c.relrowsecurity rls,c.relforcerowsecurity force_rls,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) owner,(c.relacl IS NOT NULL) explicit_acl FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('private','public') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') ORDER BY 1,2
queries.tls: SELECT s.ssl,coalesce(a.backend_type,'unknown') backend_type,CASE WHEN a.client_addr IS NULL THEN 'local_socket_or_internal' WHEN a.client_addr <<= inet '127.0.0.0/8' OR a.client_addr <<= inet '::1/128' THEN 'loopback' WHEN a.client_addr <<= inet '10.0.0.0/8' OR a.client_addr <<= inet '172.16.0.0/12' OR a.client_addr <<= inet '192.168.0.0/16' OR a.client_addr <<= inet 'fc00::/7' THEN 'private_network' ELSE 'other_network' END peer_network_class,CASE WHEN a.usename IN ('postgres','supabase_admin','supabase_auth_admin','supabase_storage_admin','supabase_realtime_admin') THEN 'system_role' WHEN a.usename IN ('authenticated','anon','authenticator','service_role') THEN 'app_role' ELSE 'other_role' END role_class,count(*) connections FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_ssl s LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid=s.pid GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,3,4
queries.settings: SELECT name,setting,source,pending_restart FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ssl','password_encryption','row_security','log_connections','log_disconnections','log_min_error_statement','log_min_duration_statement','statement_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','max_connections','shared_preload_libraries') ORDER BY name
queries.health: SELECT now()::text captured_at,current_setting('server_version') postgres_version,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type='Lock') lock_waiters,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction') idle_in_transaction_count
